name: io.github.DasDigitaleMomentum/searxncrawl
title: searxNcrawl
description: Self-hosted web search via SearXNG and clean Markdown crawling via Crawl4AI. No API key.

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your SearXNG instance with JSON output enabled (default: http://localhost:8888)

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional basic auth user for SearXNG

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional basic auth password for SearXNG

environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_RESULT_FIELDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated result fields, e.g. title,url,content,publishedDate (unset = all fields)
